results.content: Today, André continues her training / teaching and creation through dance and photography in the world of dance., as well she started her 2nd Master’s Degree, she is part of the MA in Dance Research for Professional Practitioners at Rambert School from London. **The MA in Dance Research for Professional Practitioners is a flexible two-year course, designed for professionals with at least three years’ experience in a wide range of dance practices.**. For Rambert School Kitty leads the second year of the MA Dance Research for Professional Practitioners, supporting the students’ dissertation processes. She studied an MA in Research in Practice at Rambert School from 2021-2023, focusing on the impact of NLP and coaching in dance education. This course is for dancers, choreographers, movement practitioners, educational facilitators, interdisciplinary artists, dance support facilitators and more, with a curiosity to expand their practice, and engage in practice-led enquiry within a bespoke research framework supported by experienced mentors.
